name: square-calendar-sink
description: Square calendar sync plugin for schedule and shift sink workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Sync published Square shifts into a subscribed calendar.
interface.longDescription: Creates a private, read-only ICS calendar subscription from a selected Square team member’s published shifts.
capabilities: Read published scheduled shifts from Square.
Create a private ICS subscription feed for Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and compatible clients.
Reflect updated and deleted Square shifts in the subscribed calendar.
defaultPrompt: Show the Square calendar sync setup.
